title: The New State of the War in Gaza

sentences.zh: 太空探索七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受特别优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: The accidental killing of three hostages by Israel's military has shocked Israelis and is raising new questions about the way that Israel is conducting its war against Hamas.
sentences.zh: 以色列军队意外杀害三名人质的事件震惊了以色列人，并引发了关于以色列如何对哈马斯进行战争的新质疑。

sentences.en: Today, I spoke with my colleagues Patrick Kingsley and Hiba Yezbek about whether Israel's military campaign is working and the humanitarian crisis it has left in its wake.
sentences.zh: 今天，我与同事帕特里克·金斯利和希巴·亚兹贝克讨论了以色列的军事行动是否有效，以及它所造成的后续人道主义危机。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, December 21St.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月21日，星期四。

sentences.en: So Patrick, Israel's war against Hamas is now in its 11th week.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，以色列针对哈马斯的战争现在进入了第11周。

sentences.en: And we wanted to come to you to really look closely at this question of what has Israel achieved so far in this war?
sentences.zh: 我们想找你深入探讨一个问题：以色列在这场战争中目前取得了什么成就？

sentences.en: Israel, of course, has pledged to destroy Hamas.
sentences.zh: 以色列当然已经誓言要摧毁哈马斯。

sentences.en: How far has it come on that front?
sentences.zh: 在这方面进展如何？

sentences.en: And then, late last week, something happened that seemed to make that question even more urgent.
sentences.zh: 然后，上周晚些时候发生了一件事，似乎让这个问题变得更加紧迫。

sentences.en: Israel's military accidentally killed three Israeli hostages in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 以色列军队在加沙意外杀害了三名以色列人质。

sentences.en: And the interpretation was that this symbolized some of the problems with the way Israel had been conducting the war.
sentences.zh: 人们认为这象征着以色列进行战争方式中存在的一些问题。

sentences.en: So let's start with that.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们从这件事开始说起吧。

sentences.en: Tell me about that killing and what it means.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说那次杀戮事件，以及它意味着什么。

sentences.en: Well, according to the military narrative, three hostages who were captured on October 7th during
sentences.zh: 根据军方的说法，三名人质在10月7日哈马斯领导的对以袭击中被俘，

sentences.en: the Hamas-led attack on Israel escaped their captivity and tried to make a break for freedom
sentences.zh: 他们逃脱了囚禁，并试图向以色列军队防线冲去以寻求自由，

sentences.en: towards the Israeli military lines by advancing slowly, waving a white flag, having taken off
sentences.zh: 他们缓慢前进，挥舞着白旗，脱掉了衬衫，

sentences.en: their shirts so that the Israeli soldiers would see that they were not carrying guns or strapped to any suicide bombs.
sentences.zh: 这样以色列士兵就能看到他们没有携带枪支，也没有绑着自杀式炸弹。

sentences.en: And despite that, Israeli soldiers, against the rules of war and their instructions by the military, fired on the three escaped hostages, killing two.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，以色列士兵违反了战争规则和军方指令，向这三名逃脱的人质开火，打死了两人。

sentences.en: One managed to make it into a building and shouted in Hebrew.
sentences.zh: 其中一人设法跑进了一栋建筑，并用希伯来语大喊。

sentences.en: He then left the building and was shot dead upon leaving it.
sentences.zh: 他随后离开建筑，在离开时被开枪打死。

sentences.en: And in Israel, this was seen as a huge shock and a great tragedy.
sentences.zh: 在以色列，这被视为巨大的震惊和巨大的悲剧。

sentences.en: That Israel would kill some of its own, in particular, the people that all Israelis have been rooting for for the past 11 weeks.
sentences.zh: 以色列竟然杀害了自己人，尤其是那些所有以色列人在过去11周里一直为之祈祷的人。

sentences.en: And it also raised questions about the Israeli military's conduct in general and invited accusations
sentences.zh: 这也引发了对以色列军队总体行为的质疑，并招致了指责，

sentences.en: that if this is how they treat Israelis, waving a white flag, how must the Israeli military outside of the public eye, treat Palestinian civilians in similar situations.
sentences.zh: 即如果他们对待挥舞白旗的以色列人尚且如此，那么在公众视野之外，以色列军队又是如何对待处于类似情况下的巴勒斯坦平民的呢？

sentences.en: And how does the government see that?
sentences.zh: 政府对此怎么看？

sentences.en: I mean, is this incident leading to any kind of rethinking about how it's prosecuting its war?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这件事是否导致他们重新思考如何进行这场战争？

sentences.en: Well, according to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Saturday night, no.
sentences.zh: 根据总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡周六晚上的说法，没有。

sentences.en: He said that it was Israel's military campaign in Gaza that had succeeded in releasing hundreds or so hostages in previous rounds of exchanges.
sentences.zh: 他说，正是以色列在加沙的军事行动，才成功在之前的几轮交换中释放了大约数百名人质。

sentences.en: And that only further military action in Gaza would lead to the release of more, if not all, of the Israeli hostages remaining in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 而且只有在加沙采取进一步的军事行动，才能促使更多（如果不是全部）留在加沙的以色列人质获释。

sentences.en: So according to Prime Minister Netanyahu, the strategy remains the same.
sentences.zh: 所以根据内塔尼亚胡总理的说法，战略保持不变。

sentences.en: And Israel will keep on pressing ahead with its invasion in Gaza, not only to dismantle Hamas, but also to get back its hostages.
sentences.zh: 以色列将继续推进在加沙的入侵，不仅是为了瓦解哈马斯，也是为了找回人质。

sentences.en: But two days after Netanyahu made that speech...
sentences.zh: 但在内塔尼亚胡发表那次演讲两天后……

sentences.en: Secretary Austin, the United States and Israel have never been more determined and aligned in our share values, our share interests, and our share goals.
sentences.zh: 奥斯汀部长，美国和以色列在我们的共同价值观、共同利益和共同目标上从未如此坚定和一致。

sentences.en: And his defence minister, Joab Galland, stood alongside Secretary of Defence, Austin, and it appeared to announce a shift in strategy.
sentences.zh: 他的国防部长约阿夫·加兰特与国防部长奥斯汀并肩站在一起，似乎宣布了战略上的转变。

sentences.en: Soon, we will be able to distinguish between different areas in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 很快，我们将能够区分加沙的不同区域。

sentences.en: In every area where we achieve our mission, we will be able to transition gradually to the next phase and start working on bringing back local population.
sentences.zh: 在每一个我们完成任务的区域，我们将能够逐步过渡到下一阶段，并开始着手让当地居民回归。

sentences.en: He said that soon Israel will transition gradually to another phase of the fighting and would even allow parts of the Gazan population to return to their homes.
sentences.zh: 他说，很快以色列将逐步过渡到战斗的另一个阶段，甚至会允许部分加沙居民返回家园。

sentences.en: Now, that statement from Minister Galland will have to be assessed against what Israel actually does on the ground.
sentences.zh: 现在，加兰特部长的这一声明必须结合以色列在地面上的实际行动来评估。

sentences.en: But in terms of rhetoric, it marks a significant shift.
sentences.zh: 但就言辞而言，这标志着一个重大的转变。

sentences.en: It's the clearest indication from an Israeli minister so far in the war that following weeks of pressure, Israel is preparing to slow down its military operation in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这是战争开始以来，以色列部长发出的最明确的信号，表明在经历数周压力后，以色列正准备放缓其在加沙的军事行动。

sentences.en: Which, of course, would be a huge shift in strategy.
sentences.zh: 这当然将是战略上的巨大转变。

sentences.en: And that will be something that all of us, and I'm sure you, Patrick, will be watching very closely as the weeks go on here.
sentences.zh: 随着未来几周的发展，我们所有人，我相信你，帕特里克，都会密切关注这一点。

sentences.en: Let's step back for a second and look at the broader question.
sentences.zh: 让我们退后一步，看看更广泛的问题。

sentences.en: What has Israel achieved so far militarily?
sentences.zh: 以色列在军事上目前取得了什么成就？

sentences.en: Their stated goal is to destroy Hamas.
sentences.zh: 他们宣称的目标是摧毁哈马斯。

sentences.en: Where is Israel in terms of achieving that goal?
sentences.zh: 在实现这一目标方面，以色列进展如何？

sentences.en: Israel has made some headway.
sentences.zh: 以色列取得了一些进展。

sentences.en: They have captured large parts of northern Gaza, preventing Hamas from accessing many of its
sentences.zh: 他们占领了加沙北部的大片地区，阻止了哈马斯进入其在这些地区的许多军事设施和火箭发射器，

sentences.en: military installations and rocket launchers in those areas that they would otherwise be using to fire on Israel.
sentences.zh: 否则这些设施会被用来向以色列开火。

sentences.en: They've also begun to do the same thing in the southern part of the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 他们也开始在加沙地带南部做同样的事情。

sentences.en: The Israeli military has also said that it's killed several high-ranking Hamas commanders,
sentences.zh: 以色列军方还表示，已经击毙了几名哈马斯高级指挥官，

sentences.en: including the commander of its rocket division and the commander of Hamas's so-called naval commandos, all of which, we are told, were involved in some way in the attack on Israel
sentences.zh: 包括其火箭部队指挥官和所谓的哈马斯海军突击队指挥官，据我们所知，所有这些人都在某种程度上参与了10月7日对以色列的袭击。

sentences.en: on October 7th.
What Israel has not done is establish control over all of Gaza City, which was, until the
sentences.zh: 以色列尚未完全控制整个加沙城，在入侵之前，这里至少是哈马斯在该领土的主要行政中心，因此仍然具有巨大的象征意义。

sentences.en: invasion, at least, the main administrative hub for Hamas in the territory, and which therefore still retains huge symbolic value.
sentences.zh: （象征意义）

sentences.en: And they have not captured all of Khan Yunus, the big city in southern Gaza, where we understand most of the Hamas leadership has fled to.
sentences.zh: 他们也没有占领加沙南部的大城市汗尤尼斯，据我们了解，大多数哈马斯领导层都逃到了那里。

sentences.en: And they have not killed, as they have threatened to, the top, top leadership of Hamas, including
sentences.zh: 而且他们还没有像威胁的那样，杀掉哈马斯的最高层领导人，包括

sentences.en: Yahya Sinwar, the head of Hamas in Gaza, his brother Mohammed, another powerful figure,
sentences.zh: 哈马斯在加沙的负责人叶海亚·辛瓦尔，他的兄弟、另一位有权势的人物穆罕默德，

sentences.en: Mohammed Deif, the military commander of Hamas in Gaza, and his deputy, Mahwan Issa.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯在加沙的军事指挥官穆罕默德·戴夫，以及他的副手马尔万·伊萨。

sentences.en: All four of those men and many other senior leaders in the Gaza Strip remain at large.
sentences.zh: 这四个人以及加沙地带的许多其他高级领导人仍然在逃。

sentences.en: And while they remain alive, one of the key goals that Israel's set out remains unfulfilled.
sentences.zh: 只要他们还活着，以色列设定的关键目标之一就仍未实现。

sentences.en: What about the foot soldiers?
sentences.zh: 那普通士兵呢？

sentences.en: What about the broader population of Hamas combatants?
sentences.zh: 哈马斯更广泛的战斗人员群体情况如何？

sentences.en: That is a subject of debate.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有争议的话题。

sentences.en: Hamas and the Gaza Health Authorities, which are overseen by Hamas, have not released a number
sentences.zh: 哈马斯和由哈马斯监管的加沙卫生部门，没有公布在这场战争中丧生的哈马斯和其他武装组织战士的具体人数。

sentences.en: for the number of fighters from Hamas and other armed groups who have been killed during this war.
sentences.zh: （具体人数）

sentences.en: Israel has.
sentences.zh: 以色列公布了。

sentences.en: It says that 7,000 militants have been killed by the Israeli army since October 7th.
sentences.zh: 它称自10月7日以来，以色列军队已经击毙了7000名武装分子。

sentences.en: If that is true, it accounts for roughly a quarter of the estimated 25,000 Hamas fighters that were thought to have been in Gaza at the start of the war.
sentences.zh: 如果这是真的，那么这大约占战争开始时估计在加沙的25000名哈马斯战士的四分之一。

sentences.en: We have no way of verifying the number.
sentences.zh: 我们无法核实这个数字。

sentences.en: We also don't know how much it overlaps, if at all, with the roughly 20,000 Gazans who the Gazan Health Ministry says have died during this war.
sentences.zh: 我们也不知道这个数字与加沙卫生部称在这场战争中死亡的约20000名加沙人之间有多少重叠（如果有的话）。

sentences.en: Okay, so it looks like the record so far is pretty mixed in terms of getting senior leadership of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 好吧，看来在抓捕哈马斯高级领导人方面，目前的记录相当参差不齐。

sentences.en: What has that meant in terms of how Hamas is able to operate?
sentences.zh: 这对哈马斯的运作能力意味着什么？

sentences.en: It means that Hamas can still fire some rockets into Israeli airspace, still showing that they retain some military capabilities.
sentences.zh: 这意味着哈马斯仍然可以向以色列领空发射一些火箭弹，这表明他们仍保留了一些军事能力。

sentences.en: Over the weekend in Jerusalem, we went to our bombshells after a barrage was fired into the
sentences.zh: 周末在耶路撒冷，在一阵火箭弹射向耶路撒冷上空后，我们去了我们的防空洞，

sentences.en: skies above Jerusalem, which is quite a long way from Gaza and suggests that Hamas or its allies still retain some long-range rocket capabilities.
sentences.zh: 这里距离加沙相当远，这表明哈马斯或其盟友仍保留了一些远程火箭能力。

sentences.en: And in Gaza itself, Hamas seem still very able to mount a dogged defense of its strongholds.
sentences.zh: 而在加沙内部，哈马斯似乎仍然非常有能力对其据点进行顽强的防御。

sentences.en: Every day or even several times a day, Hamas posts video propaganda videos of what it says are its fighters ambushing Israeli tanks and Israeli troops.
sentences.zh: 每天甚至一天多次，哈马斯都会发布宣传视频，展示其战士伏击以色列坦克和以色列军队的画面。

sentences.en: And there was certainly one incident in recent days in which Hamas managed to ambush nine Israeli
sentences.zh: 最近几天确实发生了一起事件，哈马斯成功伏击了九名以色列士兵，

sentences.en: soldiers, killing two very senior commanders in the field, which again just shows that Hamas remains a potent military force in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 打死了两名非常高级的战场指挥官，这再次表明哈马斯在加沙仍然是一支强大的军事力量。

sentences.en: Do we know, Patrick, on the point of the ambushes, what's the toll that this urban warfare is taking on the IDF, the Israeli military?
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，关于伏击这一点，我们知道这种城市战对以色列国防军（IDF）造成了多大的损失吗？

sentences.en: Well, since the ground invasion began in late October, more than 120 Israeli soldiers have
sentences.zh: 嗯，自10月下旬地面入侵开始以来，已有超过120名以色列士兵在加沙阵亡，

sentences.en: been killed in Gaza, making it one of the deadliest military operations for the Israeli army itself in years.
sentences.zh: 这使其成为以色列军队多年来最致命的军事行动之一。

sentences.en: And what's extraordinary about that number is that, according to our reporting, roughly 20%
sentences.zh: 这个数字最不寻常的地方在于，根据我们的报道，大约20%在加沙战争中阵亡的以色列士兵是被自己人杀死的。

sentences.en: of the Israeli soldiers killed in Gaza during this war were killed by members of their own team.
sentences.zh: 在本次战争中，在加沙阵亡的以色列士兵中，有一部分是死于己方人员之手。

sentences.en: 20% were killed by members of their own team, meaning killed accidentally by other military personnel, by the military itself.
sentences.zh: 20%是被自己人杀死的，意味着被其他军事人员意外杀害，被军队自己杀害。

sentences.en: That is a very high number and very unusual for a modern military.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常高的数字，对于现代军队来说非常罕见。

sentences.en: Like I'm thinking of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 就像我想到美国和伊拉克。

sentences.en: and Iraq.
sentences.zh: （伊拉克）

sentences.en: It was nowhere near that.
sentences.zh: 当时的情况远没有达到这种程度。

sentences.en: It seems to kind of be speaking to something going wrong on the ground, right?
sentences.zh: 这似乎说明地面上出了什么问题，对吧？

sentences.en: Like extreme chaos or just things have gotten out of control.
sentences.zh: 比如极度混乱，或者事情已经失控了。

sentences.en: That's certainly one interpretation.
sentences.zh: 这当然是一种解读。

sentences.en: We understand that the soldiers have been killed through a variety of accidental gunfire, shelling, perhaps even some airstrikes.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到，士兵们是通过各种意外枪击、炮击，甚至可能是一些空袭而丧生的。

sentences.en: A mix of causes that nevertheless add up to a broader picture, which is that a lot of mistakes are being made by the Israeli military.
sentences.zh: 多种原因混合在一起，但总的来说，反映了一个更广泛的情况，那就是以色列军队正在犯下许多错误。

sentences.en: I've been talking to our colleague Renan Bergman, who specializes in the Israeli security services.
sentences.zh: 我一直在和我们的同事雷南·伯格曼交谈，他专门研究以色列安全部门。

sentences.en: His analysis is that a lot of the troops on the ground in Gaza are actually reservists.
sentences.zh: 他的分析是，在加沙地面上的许多部队实际上是预备役军人。

sentences.en: So they're not necessarily up to speed with all the latest tactics or skills, despite several weeks of intense training at the start of the war before the invasion formally began.
sentences.zh: 所以他们不一定掌握了所有最新的战术或技能，尽管在战争开始、入侵正式开始前，他们进行了几周的强化训练。

sentences.en: And now these reservist soldiers are entering a very complex battlefield with Hamas fighters
sentences.zh: 现在这些预备役士兵进入了一个非常复杂的战场，哈马斯战士从隧道里钻出来，

sentences.en: popping out of tunnels, and mistakes are therefore happening at a staggeringly high rate.
sentences.zh: 因此错误发生的频率高得惊人。

sentences.en: So, Patrick, putting all of this together, on the one side, we have the Israeli military, which, despite making some big mistakes on the battlefield, seems to have also gained some
sentences.zh: 所以，帕特里克，综合来看，一方面，我们有以色列军队，尽管在战场上犯了一些大错，但似乎也获得了一些领土并消灭了至少一些关键的哈马斯战士。

sentences.en: territory and taken out at least some key Hamas fighters.
sentences.zh: （关键的哈马斯战士）

sentences.en: But on the other side, we have Hamas, which is still a force that's able to ambush Israelis, even in the north, and fire rockets into Israel still.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，我们有哈马斯，它仍然是一支有能力伏击以色列人（即使在北部也是如此）并继续向以色列发射火箭弹的力量。

sentences.en: So I guess going back to my original question, which was, is Israel's military campaign working?
sentences.zh: 所以我猜回到我最初的问题，那就是，以色列的军事行动有效吗？

sentences.en: It sounds like there's just not a super clear-cut answer to that.
sentences.zh: 听起来对此并没有一个非常明确的答案。

sentences.en: That's exactly it.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: In some senses, Israel has had military success, but because Israel set the bar for its victory
sentences.zh: 在某种意义上，以色列取得了军事成功，但因为以色列在10月战争开始时把胜利的门槛定得太高了，记住，他们说他们想瓦解哈马斯。

sentences.en: so high at the start of the war in October, remember, they said they wanted to dismantle Hamas.
sentences.zh: （瓦解哈马斯）

sentences.en: That means anything short of that makes it harder for Israel to declare victory.
sentences.zh: 这意味着任何低于这个目标的结果，都让以色列更难宣布胜利。

sentences.en: If Hamas's leaders are still at large, if Hamas still controls part of the territory, if they still have some rocket-launching capabilities, as they clearly do at the moment,
sentences.zh: 如果哈马斯的领导人仍然在逃，如果哈马斯仍然控制着部分领土，如果他们仍然拥有一些火箭发射能力（正如他们目前显然拥有的那样），

sentences.en: that then stops short of the goals that Israel set itself at the start of its counterattack.
sentences.zh: 那么这就没有达到以色列在反击开始时为自己设定的目标。

sentences.en: And Hamas will be able to claim that it is, in fact, the victor in this war because it is still standing.
sentences.zh: 而哈马斯将能够声称它实际上是这场战争的胜利者，因为它仍然屹立不倒。

sentences.en: And Palestinian civilians will be caught in the middle of this fight, for however long it goes on.
sentences.zh: 而巴勒斯坦平民将陷入这场战斗的中间，无论它持续多久。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The key takeaway here is the absolutely astronomical loss of civilian life in Gaza and disruption to anything like normal living inside the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 这里的关键结论是加沙平民生命的绝对天文数字般的损失，以及加沙地带内任何正常生活秩序的破坏。

sentences.en: The UN says that 85% of Gazans have been displaced from their homes.
sentences.zh: 联合国表示，85%的加沙人已经流离失所。

sentences.en: That's approaching 2 million people.
sentences.zh: 那接近200万人。

sentences.en: And even if the war was to end tomorrow, it isn't clear where many of them would be able to live.
sentences.zh: 即使战争明天结束，也不清楚他们中的许多人能住在哪里。

sentences.en: And it's unclear where all these people are supposed to go.
sentences.zh: 而且不清楚这些人该去哪里。

sentences.en: To many Israelis, this is a painful but justified response to a Hamas attack on October 7th.
sentences.zh: 对许多以色列人来说，这是对10月7日哈马斯袭击的一种痛苦但正当的回应。

sentences.en: And they need to go to these great extents in Gaza in order to prevent a repeat in the future.
sentences.zh: 他们需要在加沙采取这些极端的手段，以防止未来再次发生这种情况。

sentences.en: But to Palestinians and to many observers outside, this is an unmitigated disaster that seems to have no end.
sentences.zh: 但对巴勒斯坦人和许多外部观察家来说，这是一场似乎没有尽头的彻底灾难。

sentences.en: Patrick, thank you.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called Chromaesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Hiba, welcome to the show.
sentences.zh: 希巴，欢迎来到节目。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: So, Hiba, we just talked to our colleague Patrick Kingsley about where things stand with Israel's military campaign.
sentences.zh: 希巴，我们刚才和同事帕特里克·金斯利谈到了以色列军事行动的现状。

sentences.en: And, you know, this question of how far Israel has or has not come toward its goal of eliminating Hamas.
sentences.zh: 关于以色列在实现消灭哈马斯这一目标上进展如何的问题。

sentences.en: And he told me that has led to around 85 percent of the population of Gaza being displaced.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，这导致加沙约85%的人口流离失所。

sentences.en: So I wanted to ask you, Hiba, what does that look like in Gaza?
sentences.zh: 所以我想问问你，希巴，加沙现在是什么情况？

sentences.en: So what's been happening over the last two weeks is that just as the truce between Israel and Hamas ended,
sentences.zh: 过去两周发生的情况是，就在以色列和哈马斯之间的停火协议结束后，

sentences.en: the Israeli military began issuing orders for Gazans in the middle and southern areas of the Strip to evacuate.
sentences.zh: 以色列军方开始向加沙地带中部和南部地区的居民发出撤离令。

sentences.en: So people started fleeing to Rafah on the border with Egypt, where hundreds of thousands of others had already fled during the beginning of the war.
sentences.zh: 于是人们开始逃往与埃及接壤的拉法，战争初期已有数十万人逃往那里。

sentences.en: And in the nearly three weeks since more people started fleeing there,
sentences.zh: 而在更多人逃往那里的近三周时间里，

sentences.en: Rafah saw a 400 percent increase in its population density, according to the United Nations, which also said that it's now the most densely populated area in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 据联合国称，拉法的人口密度增加了400%，联合国还表示，这里现在是加沙人口最稠密的地区。

sentences.en: So huge number of people descending on this tiny patch of land.
sentences.zh: 所以大量人口涌入了这片狭小的土地。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And as the displacement crisis grows, conditions there are becoming increasingly worse.
sentences.zh: 随着流离失所危机的加剧，那里的状况正变得越来越糟糕。

sentences.en: The South was already overcrowded and UN shelters where most of the people that have fled to the South are staying in
sentences.zh: 南部本已人满为患，而大多数逃往南部的人所居住的联合国避难所，

sentences.en: and are mostly schools are now operating four times over their capacity.
sentences.zh: 大多是学校，现在的运营负荷已达到其容量的四倍。

sentences.en: An average of 12,000 people are staying in one UN school-turned shelter.
sentences.zh: 平均有12000人挤在一所改建为避难所的联合国学校里。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: As of now.
sentences.zh: 目前为止。

sentences.en: 12,000 people in a school?
sentences.zh: 12000人挤在一所学校里？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Sharing only a few bathrooms with no running water or access to cleaning products.
sentences.zh: 只有几个卫生间共用，没有自来水，也没有清洁用品。

sentences.en: So shelter has become a really dire problem in this trip, but it's also not the only dire problem.
sentences.zh: 所以避难所成了这里一个非常严峻的问题，但这还不是唯一的问题。

sentences.en: Food shortages are leading people to go hungry.
sentences.zh: 粮食短缺导致人们挨饿。

sentences.en: The UN recently found that 50 percent of displaced families in Gaza reported having members who go to sleep hungry at night.
sentences.zh: 联合国最近发现，加沙50%的流离失所家庭报告称有成员晚上饿着肚子睡觉。

sentences.en: And on top of the hunger, access to clean water has been a major issue in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 除了饥饿，获得清洁用水也是加沙的一个主要问题。

sentences.en: People have struggled to find clean drinking water.
sentences.zh: 人们一直在努力寻找干净的饮用水。

sentences.en: And I've resulted to drinking salty water, seawater, water that hasn't been filtered.
sentences.zh: 结果只能喝咸水、海水，或者未经过滤的水。

sentences.en: And, you know, speaking to people over the last few weeks, they've told me that a lot of them have went days with only drinking one cup of water.
sentences.zh: 过去几周我与人们交谈时，他们告诉我，很多人好几天只喝一杯水。

sentences.en: And now what we're seeing amid all of these horrible conditions is that cases of infectious diseases are being reported.
sentences.zh: 现在，在所有这些可怕的条件下，我们看到传染病病例正在被报告。

sentences.en: The World Health Organization said last week that at least 369,000 cases of infectious diseases have been reported in Gaza since the war began.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织上周表示，自战争开始以来，加沙已报告了至少36.9万例传染病病例。

sentences.en: And all of these numbers are estimated to be very underreported because many people who are sick are unable to reach a hospital or a clinic to get diagnosed.
sentences.zh: 而且所有这些数字都被严重低估了，因为许多病人无法到达医院或诊所进行诊断。

sentences.en: So we don't really know the real number.
sentences.zh: 所以我们并不真正知道真实的数字。

sentences.en: But the more people are crowded together and sharing bathrooms and drinking contaminated water, the more we're going to see people getting sick.
sentences.zh: 但人们挤在一起、共用卫生间、饮用受污染的水的情况越多，我们就会看到越多的人生病。

sentences.en: The truth is that I've been reporting on Gaza since the start of the fighting, and I've spoken to dozens of people from across the Strip.
sentences.zh: 事实是，自战斗开始以来，我一直在报道加沙的情况，我与加沙地带各地的几十个人交谈过。

sentences.en: But, you know, me and other reporters, we're not there.
sentences.zh: 但是，我和其他记者并不在那里。

sentences.en: We're not on the ground.
sentences.zh: 我们不在实地。

sentences.en: I am personally based in Jerusalem, and we're not able to go in and report from there.
sentences.zh: 我本人常驻耶路撒冷，我们无法进入那里进行报道。

sentences.en: So we start most of our days, you know, my colleagues and I, with basically scrambling to reach anyone on the ground.
sentences.zh: 所以我和同事们大部分时间都是在匆忙联系实地的人。

sentences.en: Sometimes we would call people all day and reach one person.
sentences.zh: 有时我们整天都在打电话，却只能联系上一个人。

sentences.en: Some days we would reach no one.
sentences.zh: 有时一个人也联系不上。

sentences.en: And, you know, often I would call someone to ask about something specific, and they would immediately start telling me about their desperate situation.
sentences.zh: 而且，我经常打电话给某人询问具体情况，他们会立即开始向我诉说他们绝望的处境。

sentences.en: Without me even asking, they would tell me how they're staying in overcrowded shelters, and they're with people they don't even know, that their kids are sick, that they are,
sentences.zh: 我还没问，他们就会告诉我他们住在拥挤的避难所里，和不认识的人住在一起，他们的孩子生病了，他们，

sentences.en: you know, hungry and thirsty, that they can't even go to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 又饿又渴，甚至连厕所都上不了。

sentences.en: And when they do, they have to queue for hours to get in, and it's not even clean.
sentences.zh: 即使能上，也要排几个小时的队，而且厕所根本不干净。

sentences.en: So it's been almost like every story has had those themes running through it.
sentences.zh: 所以几乎每个故事都贯穿着这些主题。

sentences.en: But one woman's story really stuck with me, and my colleague, Amira Haruda, spoke to her a week ago over the phone.
sentences.zh: 但有一位女性的故事让我印象深刻，我的同事阿米拉·哈鲁达一周前通过电话采访了她。

sentences.en: Her name is Samah Al-Farra.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫萨玛·法拉。

sentences.en: Samah is a 46-year-old mother of 10.
sentences.zh: 萨玛是一位46岁的母亲，有10个孩子。

sentences.en: Her oldest son is 24, and her youngest daughter is 6.
sentences.zh: 她的大儿子24岁，最小的女儿6岁。

sentences.en: And they fled from the north during the first few weeks of fighting.
sentences.zh: 他们在战斗的最初几周从北部逃了出来。

sentences.en: And after moving around a few times, they ended up all sharing one tent at a UN shelter on the beach in Rafah.
sentences.zh: 在几次搬迁后，他们最终都挤在拉法海滩上一个联合国避难所的帐篷里。

sentences.en: And from what she was describing, it is a horrible situation.
sentences.zh: 根据她的描述，那里的情况非常可怕。

sentences.en: They're sleeping on the sand that she says was not clean because people were dumping dirty water there,
sentences.zh: 他们睡在沙地上，她说沙地不干净，因为人们在那里倾倒脏水，

sentences.en: because the rains were causing the sand to become muddy, and because there's no sanitation or sewage systeMs.
sentences.zh: 因为雨水导致沙地变得泥泞，而且那里没有卫生或污水处理系统。

sentences.en: There's also no garbage collecting services in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 加沙也没有垃圾收集服务。

sentences.en: And what we're seeing is that garbage is piling up nearly everywhere, and the beach is no exception.
sentences.zh: 我们看到垃圾几乎堆积在任何地方，海滩也不例外。

sentences.en: And now that it's winter, and the temperatures are dropping, you know, it's getting cold, and it's a tent.
sentences.zh: 现在是冬天，气温在下降，天气变冷了，而他们住的是帐篷。

sentences.en: It doesn't protect them.
sentences.zh: 帐篷保护不了他们。

sentences.en: And at one point during the interview,
sentences.zh: 在采访过程中，

sentences.en: My colleague Amira asked her if she feels safe, and she immediately said no.
sentences.zh: 我的同事阿米拉问她是否感到安全，她立刻回答说没有。

sentences.en: She said that they can hear the sound of Israeli airstrikes above them at night.
sentences.zh: 她说晚上能听到头顶上方以色列空袭的声音。

sentences.en: They're not able to sleep because of the anxiety and the fear, knowing that bombs are being dropped around them.
sentences.zh: 因为焦虑和恐惧，他们无法入睡，因为知道炸弹就在他们周围落下。

sentences.en: And when we asked her, what are they eating?
sentences.zh: 当我们问她，他们吃什么时？

sentences.en: She said nothing.
sentences.zh: 她说没什么可吃的。

sentences.en: They don't have anything to eat.
sentences.zh: 他们没有任何东西吃。

sentences.en: And she told us that her six-year-old was so hungry that she would always ask for food.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们，她六岁的孩子饿得总是要吃的。

sentences.en: She would say, Mama, I want food.
sentences.zh: 她会说，妈妈，我想要吃的。

sentences.en: Mama, I want food.
sentences.zh: 妈妈，我想要吃的。

sentences.en: But she had nothing to give her.
sentences.zh: 但她什么也给不了她。

sentences.en: She told us that she's been going around her area, knocking on people's doors, and asking if they could spare some clean water for her to give to her children.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们，她一直在她所在的区域到处敲门，问人们能否匀出一点干净的水给她孩子喝。

sentences.en: So she's actually begging for clean water.
sentences.zh: 所以她实际上是在乞求干净的水。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what about water to wash and bathe her children in?
sentences.zh: 那用来洗漱和给孩子洗澡的水呢？

sentences.en: Well, they're using contaminated water that she told us smells really bad.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们用的是受污染的水，她告诉我们那水闻起来非常难闻。

sentences.en: And they're using that to drink and to wash.
sentences.zh: 他们用这些水来喝和洗澡。

sentences.en: And she was telling us how when she washed her hands in this water, she felt dirtier and not cleaner, that her hands smelled worse after she washed them.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们，当她用这些水洗手时，她感觉手更脏了，而不是更干净，洗完后手上的味道更难闻了。

sentences.en: And the lack of clean water meant that they haven't been able to shower or clean themselves.
sentences.zh: 缺乏干净的水意味着他们无法洗澡或清洁身体。

sentences.en: And she told us that two of her daughters, her youngest, have lice.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们，她的两个女儿，也就是最小的两个，长了虱子。

sentences.en: And she can't even brush their hair or wash it because she can't afford shampoo.
sentences.zh: 她甚至没法给她们梳头或洗头，因为她买不起洗发水。

sentences.en: So she was considering cutting their hair just to avoid that altogether.
sentences.zh: 所以她考虑干脆把她们的头发剪掉，以避免这些问题。

sentences.en: They've also got skin rashes and have been itching uncontrollably.
sentences.zh: 她们还长了皮疹，痒得无法控制。

sentences.en: But the most striking fact about this family is that only days after arriving at this UN shelter on the beach, the entire family began feeling sick.
sentences.zh: 但关于这个家庭最令人震惊的事实是，在到达海滩这个联合国避难所仅几天后，全家人就开始生病了。

sentences.en: She was telling us how all of her children, as well as herself, have had a high fever
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们，她所有的孩子以及她自己都发了高烧，

sentences.en: and have been vomiting and having diarrhea.
sentences.zh: 并且一直在呕吐和腹泻。

sentences.en: And they haven't been able to go to a hospital or to see a doctor for several reasons.
sentences.zh: 由于种种原因，他们无法去医院或看医生。

sentences.en: One being that hospitals are completely overwhelmed and there won't be anyone available to help them there.
sentences.zh: 一是医院已经完全不堪重负，那里没有人能帮到他们。

sentences.en: And they're new to the area.
sentences.zh: 而且他们对这个地区很陌生。

sentences.en: They don't know Rafah, so they don't know which clinics exist and if they're even open or operational.
sentences.zh: 他们不了解拉法，所以不知道有哪些诊所，也不知道它们是否开门或正常运作。

sentences.en: And even if they did find the clinic, she told us that they were too weak to walk there.
sentences.zh: 即使他们找到了诊所，她也告诉我们，他们太虚弱了，走不到那里。

sentences.en: So they have nothing to do except wait it out.
sentences.zh: 所以除了硬扛，他们别无他法。

sentences.en: So she hasn't actually had a diagnosis then because she actually can't get to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 所以她实际上并没有得到诊断，因为她根本去不了医院。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: She was telling us that her nine-year-old son was having seizures from what she assumed was the high fever, but she couldn't know for sure.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们，她九岁的儿子因为她推测是高烧的原因而抽搐，但她无法确定。

sentences.en: And she was telling us how her six-year-old daughter, Hala, is so weak that she's sleeping all day.
sentences.zh: 她还告诉我们，她六岁的女儿哈拉太虚弱了，整天都在睡觉。

sentences.en: She's lying down and she is too tired to even scratch her own skin.
sentences.zh: 她躺在那里，累得连抓自己的皮肤都没有力气。

sentences.en: So she's been asking her mom to scratch it for her.
sentences.zh: 所以她一直让妈妈帮她抓。

sentences.en: And she is now too weak to ask for food.
sentences.zh: 她现在虚弱得连要吃的力气都没有了。

sentences.en: So she's no longer begging for food.
sentences.zh: 所以她不再乞求食物了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: She cannot eat.
sentences.zh: 她吃不下东西。

sentences.en: She feels really helpless and there are not many options for her to help her kids.
sentences.zh: 她感到非常无助，没有什么办法能帮到她的孩子。

sentences.en: And she told us that although they've been there for only a week at the shelter, but it feels like 60 years for her.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我们，虽然他们在避难所只待了一周，但对她来说感觉像过了60年。

sentences.en: Because every day has been so difficult on its own.
sentences.zh: 因为每一天都过得如此艰难。

sentences.en: And have you been in touch with Samah since then?
sentences.zh: 那之后你和萨玛还有联系吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: My colleague Amira and I have been trying to reach her for days.
sentences.zh: 我和同事阿米拉已经好几天联系不上她了。

sentences.en: But we don't know what Samah and her family are going through now.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道萨玛和她的家人现在经历了什么。

sentences.en: We don't know if they've gotten better or if they've gotten worse.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他们的情况是好转了还是恶化了。

sentences.en: We don't know if Samah and her children are still alive.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道萨玛和她的孩子们是否还活着。

sentences.en: So Hiba, you've watched this change over the last few weeks in Gaza, this real breakdown in conditions on the ground.
sentences.zh: 希巴，你目睹了过去几周加沙的变化，目睹了当地状况的真正崩溃。

sentences.en: What are you going to be watching for in the next few weeks?
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，你会关注什么？

sentences.en: The next few weeks in Gaza are probably going to be very difficult.
sentences.zh: 加沙接下来的几周可能会非常艰难。

sentences.en: The World Health Organization said that they estimate that more people could die at the end of all of this from infectious diseases and hunger than from airstrikes.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织表示，他们估计在这一切结束时，死于传染病和饥饿的人数可能比死于空袭的人数还要多。

sentences.en: And we're going to start seeing more and more dire conditions in the south, specifically in Rafah, as more people flee there.
sentences.zh: 随着更多人逃往南部，特别是在拉法，我们将看到南部出现越来越多严峻的情况。

sentences.en: And as supplies continue to dwindle and as hospitals continue to go out of service.
sentences.zh: 随着物资持续减少，医院继续停止服务。

sentences.en: So the next couple of weeks in Gaza are going to be very difficult.
sentences.zh: 所以加沙接下来的几周将会非常艰难。

sentences.en: And I don't really know what will happen.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道会发生什么。

sentences.en: But I keep thinking back to all the people I've spoken to over the last few weeks.
sentences.zh: 但我不断回想起过去几周我交谈过的所有人。

sentences.en: And what they told me is that all they want is to be able to sleep for a full night uninterrupted, even sleep in their own beds, go back to their homes that they've left,
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我，他们想要的只是能睡个安稳觉，哪怕是睡在自己的床上，回到他们离开的家，

sentences.en: to share a meal with family members or even see family members that they haven't been able to see for weeks, and to take a warm shower.
sentences.zh: 和家人一起吃顿饭，或者见见几周没见到的家人，洗个热水澡。

sentences.en: Just simple, daily things that we take for granted, but that feel impossible for people in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这些我们认为理所当然的简单日常琐事，对加沙的人民来说却感觉遥不可及。

sentences.en: Hiba, thank you.
sentences.zh: 希巴，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, European countries struck a major deal to overhaul their migration system in an effort to address surging anti-immigrant sentiment
sentences.zh: 周三，欧洲国家达成了一项重大协议，旨在改革其移民系统，以应对日益高涨的反移民情绪，

sentences.en: that is fueling the rise of far-right political parties across the continent.
sentences.zh: 这种情绪正在助推整个欧洲大陆极右翼政党的崛起。

sentences.en: The agreement will make it easier to deport failed asylum seekers and to limit entry of migrants into the European Union.
sentences.zh: 该协议将使驱逐未获庇护的申请者变得更容易，并限制移民进入欧盟。

sentences.en: It seeks to give governments a greater sense of control over their borders while bolstering the EU's role in migration, treating it as a European issue, not just a national one.
sentences.zh: 它旨在让各国政府在边境管控方面拥有更大的自主权，同时加强欧盟在移民问题上的作用，将其视为一个欧洲问题，而不仅仅是国家问题。

sentences.en: The agreement has been in the works for years, but negotiators were under pressure to finalize it ahead of elections this summer across the bloc's 27 nations.
sentences.zh: 该协议酝酿多年，但谈判代表们面临着在今年夏天欧盟27国选举前敲定协议的压力。

sentences.zh: 里基·诺韦茨基、西德尼·哈珀和戴安娜·阮参与制作。

sentences.zh: 由马克·乔治和琳赛·加里森编辑，丽莎·周提供协助。

sentences.zh: 事实核查由苏珊·李完成，包含丹·鲍威尔和帕特·麦卡斯克的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听关于如何让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会睡到不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
